format: html

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-latest.min.js"></script>

```

Bubble charts are perfect for comparing magnitude and category in one glance. Here, our **Dual Bubble Chart** plots rental rate on the x-axis and homeownership rate on the y-axis, with:

- **Bubble size** indicating metro population  
- **Bubble color** encoding a third factor of your choice (e.g., GDP growth, mortgage rate)

Use the dropdown menu to select which macroeconomic factor drives the color scale. Notice how high-growth, low-rate regions cluster differently than those with weaker economies or steeper borrowing costs. Hover over each bubble to see exact values and the city name.

<style>
  .controls { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .controls label { margin: 0 20px; font-size: 16px; }
  #chartA, #chartB {
    width: 90%;
    height: 350px;
    margin: 0 auto 50px;
  }
</style>

<div class="controls">
  <label>
    Rate:
    <select id="rateSel">
      <option value="RentalRate">Rental Rate</option>
      <option value="HomeownershipRate">Homeownership Rate</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <label>
    Metric:
    <select id="metricSel">
      <option value="CPI">CPI</option>
      <option value="National_Unemployment">Unemployment Rate</option>
    </select>
  </label>
</div>

<div id="chartA"></div>
<div id="chartB"></div>

<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v5.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-latest.min.js"></script>
<script>
d3.csv("../data/All_merged.csv").then(raw => {
  const data = raw.map(d=>({
    year: +d.Year,
    CPI: +d.CPI,
    National_Unemployment: +d.National_Unemployment,
    RentalRate: +d.RentalRate,
    HomeownershipRate: +d.HomeownershipRate,
    RenterAffordability: +d.RenterAffordability,
    HomeownerAffordability: +d.HomeownerAffordability
  }));
  function aggByYear(xKey,yKey,sizeKey){
    return d3.nest()
      .key(d=>d.year)
      .entries(data)
      .sort((a,b)=>+a.key - +b.key)
      .map(g=>{
        const vals=g.values;
        return {
          year: +g.key,
          x: d3.mean(vals,d=>d[xKey]),
          y: d3.mean(vals,d=>d[yKey]),
          size: d3.mean(vals,d=>d[sizeKey])
        };
      });
  }
  const colorMap = {
    RentalRate:        "#DCBB5E",
    HomeownershipRate: "#17084A"
  };
  function draw(){
    const rateKey   = rateSel.value,
          otherKey  = rateKey==="RentalRate" ? "HomeownershipRate" : "RentalRate",
          affordKey = rateKey==="RentalRate" ? "RenterAffordability" : "HomeownerAffordability",
          metricKey = metricSel.value;
    // swap: x=rate, y=metric
    const A = aggByYear(rateKey, metricKey, affordKey),
          B = aggByYear(otherKey, metricKey, affordKey),
          maxSize = d3.max(A.concat(B), d=>d.size);
    function makeTrace(arr,key){
      return {
        x: arr.map(d=>d.x),
        y: arr.map(d=>d.y),
        mode: "markers",
        marker: {
          size: arr.map(d=>Math.sqrt(d.size/maxSize)*40 + 10),
          color: colorMap[key],
          opacity: 0.6,
          line: { width:1, color:"#444" }
        },
        text: arr.map(d=>
          `Year: ${d.year}`+
          `<br>${rateSel.value.replace(/([A-Z])/g," $1")}: ${d.x.toFixed(2)}`+
          `<br>${metricKey}: ${d.y.toFixed(2)}`+
          `<br>Afford.: ${d.size.toFixed(2)}`
        ),
        hoverinfo:"text",
        name: key,
        showlegend:false
      };
    }
    const traceA = makeTrace(A, rateKey),
          traceB = makeTrace(B, otherKey);
    const layoutA = {
      title: { text:`${rateSel.value.replace(/([A-Z])/g," $1")} vs ${metricSel.value}`, x:0.5 },
      xaxis: { title: rateSel.value.replace(/([A-Z])/g," $1"), automargin:true },
      yaxis: { title: metricSel.value, automargin:true },
      margin:{l:60,r:50,t:50,b:80},
      transition:{duration:600,easing:"cubic-in-out"}
    };
    const layoutB = {
      title: { text:`${otherKey.replace(/([A-Z])/g," $1")} vs ${metricSel.value}`, x:0.5 },
      xaxis: { title: otherKey.replace(/([A-Z])/g," $1"), automargin:true },
      yaxis: { title: metricSel.value, automargin:true },
      margin:{l:60,r:50,t:50,b:80},
      transition:{duration:600,easing:"cubic-in-out"}
    };
    Plotly.react("chartA",[traceA],layoutA,{displayModeBar:false});
    Plotly.react("chartB",[traceB],layoutB,{displayModeBar:false});
  }
  const rateSel   = document.getElementById("rateSel"),
        metricSel = document.getElementById("metricSel");
  rateSel.addEventListener("change", draw);
  metricSel.addEventListener("change", draw);
  draw();
});
</script>
